IMF-001.name: Cat-Cow
IMF-001.desc: On hands and knees, arch your back up, then let it sink down, slowly.

IMF-002.name: Bird Dog
IMF-002.desc: On hands and knees, reach one arm and the opposite leg straight out, then switch.

IMF-004.name: Standing Hip Circles
IMF-004.desc: Stand on one leg, draw big slow circles with the other knee.

IMF-005.name: Leg Swings
IMF-005.desc: Hold a wall, swing one leg forward and back like a pendulum, then turn and swing it side to side across your body.

IMF-007.name: 90/90 Hip Switches
IMF-007.desc: Sit with both knees bent at right angles, rotate your knees to the other side.

IMF-008.name: Hip Flexor Stretch, Half Kneeling
IMF-008.desc: One knee down, other foot forward, gently shift your hips forward.

IMF-009.name: Walking Knee Hugs
IMF-009.desc: Step forward, pull one knee to your chest, switch with each step.

IMF-010.name: Walking Lunge with Reach
IMF-010.desc: Step into a short lunge, stay tall, reach arms overhead.

IMF-011.name: World's Greatest Stretch
IMF-011.desc: Lunge position, hand down inside the front foot, rotate your chest toward the ceiling.

IMF-012.name: Thread the Needle
IMF-012.desc: On hands and knees, slide one arm under your body to twist your upper back.

IMF-014.name: Wall Slides
IMF-014.desc: Back against a wall, slide your arms up and down like making a snow angel.

IMF-015.name: Arm Circles
IMF-015.desc: Arms out to the sides, draw small then bigger circles.

IMF-019.name: Bodyweight Squat to Box
IMF-019.desc: Sit back until you lightly touch a box or bench, then stand up.

IMF-020.name: Light Treadmill Walk
IMF-020.desc: Easy walk to raise your heart rate and warm up.

IMF-022.name: Elliptical, Easy Pace
IMF-022.desc: Smooth gliding motion with arms and legs at a comfortable effort.

IMF-023.name: Rowing Machine, Easy Pace
IMF-023.desc: Push with your legs, lean back slightly, pull the handle to your ribs, at a light effort.

IMF-024.name: Dead Bug
IMF-024.desc: On your back, arms up and knees bent, slowly lower the opposite arm and leg, keep your lower back flat.

IMF-026.name: Pallof Press
IMF-026.desc: Stand sideways to a cable, press the handle straight out and resist being twisted.

IMF-028.name: Plank, Forearms
IMF-028.desc: Hold a straight body line on your forearms and toes.

IMF-029.name: Plank, Hands
IMF-029.desc: Hold a straight body line on your hands and toes.
IMF-029.note: Image shows forearms on the floor. Hold the same straight line with straight arms and hands under your shoulders.

IMF-030.name: Side Plank
IMF-030.desc: Lie on your side, lift your hips so your body forms a straight line, hold.

IMF-035.name: Suitcase Carry
IMF-035.desc: Carry one heavy weight in one hand and walk tall without leaning.

IMF-036.name: Farmer's Carry
IMF-036.desc: Carry a heavy weight in each hand and walk tall.

IMF-039.name: Reverse Crunch
IMF-039.desc: On your back, curl your knees toward your chest by lifting your hips slightly.

IMF-040.name: Lying Leg Raise, Bent Knee
IMF-040.desc: On your back, lift bent knees up and lower them slowly.

IMF-041.name: Hanging Knee Raise
IMF-041.desc: Hang from a bar and pull your knees up toward your chest.

IMF-042.name: Hanging Leg Raise
IMF-042.desc: Hang from a bar and lift straight legs up in front of you.

IMF-043.name: Cable Crunch
IMF-043.desc: Kneel at a cable machine, curl your ribs toward your hips.

IMF-044.name: Machine Crunch
IMF-044.desc: Sit in the ab machine and curl forward against the weight.

IMF-045.name: Bicycle Crunch
IMF-045.desc: On your back, bring opposite elbow and knee together in a pedaling motion.

IMF-046.name: Heel Taps
IMF-046.desc: On your back, knees bent, reach down to tap each heel with the same side hand.

IMF-047.name: Mountain Climbers
IMF-047.desc: In a push-up position, drive your knees toward your chest quickly, one at a time.

IMF-048.name: Cable Woodchop, High to Low
IMF-048.desc: Pull a cable from above one shoulder down across your body.

IMF-049.name: Cable Woodchop, Low to High
IMF-049.desc: Pull a cable from low by your hip up across your body.

IMF-050.name: Russian Twist
IMF-050.desc: Sit leaning back slightly, rotate your torso side to side.

IMF-051.name: Ab Wheel Rollout
IMF-051.desc: Kneel and roll a wheel forward then pull it back.

IMF-052.name: Sit-Up
IMF-052.desc: Lie on your back, curl all the way up to sitting, then lower down.

IMF-054.name: Single-Leg Glute Bridge
IMF-054.desc: Lift your hips with one foot on the floor and the other leg straight.

IMF-055.name: Clamshell with Band
IMF-055.desc: Lie on your side, knees bent, band above knees, open the top knee like a clam.

IMF-056.name: Side-Lying Leg Raise
IMF-056.desc: Lie on your side and lift your top leg straight up and down.

IMF-057.name: Fire Hydrant
IMF-057.desc: On hands and knees, lift one bent knee out to the side.

IMF-058.name: Banded Lateral Walk
IMF-058.desc: Band around your thighs, small bent knees, step sideways.

IMF-059.name: Banded Monster Walk
IMF-059.desc: Band around your thighs, step forward and slightly out in a wide waddle.

IMF-060.name: Quadruped Hip Extension
IMF-060.desc: On hands and knees, press one foot up toward the ceiling, also called donkey kick.

IMF-061.name: Back Extension, Bodyweight
IMF-061.desc: Face down on a bench, lift your upper body up and lower.

IMF-062.name: Superman Hold
IMF-062.desc: Lie face down, lift arms and legs off the floor and hold.

IMF-063.name: Goblet Squat
IMF-063.desc: Hold one weight at your chest, squat down and stand up.

IMF-064.name: Box Squat
IMF-064.desc: Sit back onto a box or bench with control, then stand up.

IMF-065.name: Leg Press
IMF-065.desc: Sit in the machine, push the platform away with feet in the middle.

IMF-068.name: Single-Leg Leg Press
IMF-068.desc: Push the platform with one leg at a time.
IMF-068.note: Image shows both legs. Press with one leg at a time.

IMF-069.name: Hack Squat Machine
IMF-069.desc: Shoulders against pads, squat down and up on an angled track.

IMF-070.name: Smith Machine Squat
IMF-070.desc: Squat with a bar that slides on fixed rails, bar on your upper back.

IMF-071.name: Smith Machine Split Squat
IMF-071.desc: One foot forward, one back, lower and rise using the fixed bar.

IMF-072.name: Bulgarian Split Squat, Controlled Depth
IMF-072.desc: Back foot on a bench, lower your front leg only as far as you can stay in control.

IMF-073.name: Split Squat, Stationary
IMF-073.desc: Feet in a long stance, lower straight down and up without stepping.

IMF-074.name: Reverse Lunge, Upright Torso
IMF-074.desc: Step backward, lower your knee, keep your chest tall.

IMF-075.name: Walking Lunge, Short Step
IMF-075.desc: Take small steps forward, lowering a little each time.

IMF-076.name: Step-Up to Box
IMF-076.desc: Step onto a box with one foot, stand tall, step back down.

IMF-077.name: Lateral Step-Up
IMF-077.desc: Stand beside a box, step up sideways, stand, lower back down.

IMF-078.name: Lateral Lunge
IMF-078.desc: Step wide to one side, sit back into that hip, push back to center.

IMF-079.name: Curtsy Lunge
IMF-079.desc: Step one foot behind and across, like a curtsy, then stand up.

IMF-081.name: Wall Sit
IMF-081.desc: Back against a wall, thighs level with the floor, hold still.

IMF-082.name: Leg Extension
IMF-082.desc: Sit in the machine and straighten your knees against the pad.

IMF-083.name: Single-Leg Leg Extension
IMF-083.desc: Straighten one knee at a time on the machine.

IMF-084.name: Barbell Back Squat
IMF-084.desc: Bar on your upper back, squat down and stand up.

IMF-085.name: Barbell Front Squat
IMF-085.desc: Bar resting on the front of your shoulders, squat down and stand up.

IMF-086.name: Overhead Squat
IMF-086.desc: Hold a bar straight overhead while squatting.

IMF-087.name: Jump Squat
IMF-087.desc: Squat down, then jump up explosively and land softly.

IMF-088.name: Box Jump
IMF-088.desc: Jump from the floor onto a sturdy box and step down.

IMF-089.name: Pistol Squat to Box
IMF-089.desc: Squat on one leg down to a box, other leg held out front.

IMF-090.name: Glute Bridge
IMF-090.desc: On your back, knees bent, lift your hips by squeezing your glutes.

IMF-091.name: Barbell Glute Bridge
IMF-091.desc: Same bridge with a bar resting across your hips.

IMF-092.name: Hip Thrust, Machine
IMF-092.desc: Back on a pad, drive your hips up against the machine's resistance.

IMF-093.name: Hip Thrust, Barbell
IMF-093.desc: Upper back on a bench, bar across your hips, drive hips up.

IMF-095.name: Cable Pull-Through
IMF-095.desc: Face away from a cable, hinge your hips back, then squeeze your glutes to stand tall.

IMF-096.name: Cable Kickback
IMF-096.desc: Ankle strap on a cable, kick one leg straight back.

IMF-097.name: Machine Glute Kickback
IMF-097.desc: Press one foot back against a pad on the kickback machine.

IMF-098.name: Seated Leg Curl
IMF-098.desc: Sit in the machine and pull the pad down by bending your knees.

IMF-099.name: Lying Leg Curl
IMF-099.desc: Lie face down and curl the pad toward your glutes.

IMF-100.name: Standing Single-Leg Curl
IMF-100.desc: Stand and curl one heel toward your glute on the machine.

IMF-101.name: Stability Ball Leg Curl
IMF-101.desc: On your back, heels on a ball, lift hips and roll the ball in.

IMF-102.name: Slider Leg Curl
IMF-102.desc: On your back, heels on sliders, lift hips and slide your heels in and out.

IMF-105.name: Reverse Hyperextension
IMF-105.desc: Lie face down on a pad, swing your legs up and back.

IMF-106.name: Romanian Deadlift with Dumbbells
IMF-106.desc: Straight-leg deadlift keeping your back flat, weights slide down your thighs.

IMF-108.name: Single-Leg Romanian Deadlift
IMF-108.desc: Balance on one leg, hinge forward with the other leg reaching back.

IMF-109.name: Conventional Deadlift
IMF-109.desc: Lift a bar from the floor to standing.

IMF-110.name: Sumo Deadlift

IMF-111.name: Trap Bar Deadlift
IMF-111.desc: Stand inside a hexagon bar, lift it by standing up.

IMF-112.name: Good Morning
IMF-112.desc: Bar on your back, bow forward at the hips, then stand up.

IMF-113.name: Kettlebell Swing
IMF-113.desc: Swing a kettlebell from between your legs up to chest height by snapping your hips.

IMF-114.name: Hip Abduction Machine
IMF-114.desc: Sit and push your knees apart against pads.

IMF-115.name: Hip Adduction Machine
IMF-115.desc: Sit and squeeze your knees together against pads.

IMF-116.name: Cable Hip Abduction
IMF-116.desc: Ankle strap on a cable, lift your leg out to the side.

IMF-117.name: Cable Hip Adduction
IMF-117.desc: Ankle strap on a cable, pull your leg across in front of the other.

IMF-118.name: Standing Calf Raise
IMF-118.desc: Stand and rise up onto your toes, then lower.

IMF-119.name: Seated Calf Raise
IMF-119.desc: Sit with weight on your knees, rise onto your toes.

IMF-120.name: Leg Press Calf Raise
IMF-120.desc: On the leg press, push the platform with only your toes.

IMF-123.name: Dumbbell Bench Press, Flat

IMF-124.name: Dumbbell Bench Press, Incline

IMF-125.name: Dumbbell Bench Press, Decline
IMF-125.desc: Same press on a bench tilted down, works lower chest.

IMF-126.name: Barbell Bench Press, Flat
IMF-126.desc: Lie on a bench, lower a bar to your chest and press it up.

IMF-127.name: Barbell Bench Press, Incline
IMF-127.desc: Same with the bench tilted up.

IMF-128.name: Machine Chest Press
IMF-128.desc: Sit and push two handles forward.

IMF-129.name: Machine Incline Press
IMF-129.desc: Sit and push handles forward and upward.

IMF-130.name: Smith Machine Bench Press
IMF-130.desc: Bench press with a bar on fixed rails.

IMF-131.name: Smith Machine Incline Press
IMF-131.desc: Incline bench press with a bar on fixed rails.

IMF-132.name: Push-Up
IMF-132.desc: Hands on the floor, lower your chest down and push back up.

IMF-133.name: Push-Up, Incline
IMF-133.desc: Hands on a bench or bar, easier version.

IMF-134.name: Push-Up, Decline
IMF-134.desc: Feet on a bench, harder version.

IMF-135.name: Push-Up, Knees
IMF-135.desc: Push-up with your knees on the floor.

IMF-137.name: Dumbbell Fly, Flat
IMF-137.desc: Lie on a bench, open your arms wide with a slight bend, then bring the weights together.

IMF-138.name: Dumbbell Fly, Incline
IMF-138.desc: Same fly on an inclined bench.

IMF-139.name: Cable Crossover, High to Low
IMF-139.desc: Pull cable handles from above down and together in front of your hips.

IMF-140.name: Cable Crossover, Low to High
IMF-140.desc: Pull cable handles from low up and together in front of your chest.

IMF-142.name: Pec Deck Machine
IMF-142.desc: Sit and bring two arms together in front of your chest.

IMF-143.name: Single-Arm Cable Press

IMF-144.name: Landmine Press
IMF-144.desc: Press the end of an anchored bar up and forward.

IMF-145.name: Dumbbell Pullover
IMF-145.desc: Lie on a bench, move one dumbbell in an arc from over your chest to behind your head.

IMF-146.name: Svend Press

IMF-147.name: Dips, Chest Lean

IMF-148.name: Floor Press with Dumbbells
IMF-148.desc: Lie on the floor, press dumbbells up, elbows stop when they touch the floor.

IMF-149.name: Lat Pulldown, Wide Grip

IMF-150.name: Lat Pulldown, Close Grip
IMF-150.desc: Same pulldown with hands closer together.

IMF-151.name: Lat Pulldown, Neutral Grip

IMF-152.name: Single-Arm Lat Pulldown
IMF-152.desc: Pull one handle down at a time.

IMF-153.name: Straight-Arm Pulldown
IMF-153.desc: Stand at a cable, keep arms nearly straight, sweep the bar down to your thighs.

IMF-154.name: Pull-Up

IMF-155.name: Chin-Up
IMF-155.desc: Hang from a bar with palms facing you, pull your chin over the bar.

IMF-156.name: Assisted Pull-Up Machine
IMF-156.desc: Pull-up with the machine taking some of your body weight.

IMF-157.name: Seated Cable Row, Close Grip
IMF-157.desc: Sit and pull a close handle to your stomach.

IMF-158.name: Seated Cable Row, Wide Grip
IMF-158.desc: Sit and pull a wide bar to your lower chest.

IMF-159.name: Chest-Supported Row Machine
IMF-159.desc: Chest against a pad, pull handles back.

IMF-160.name: Chest-Supported Dumbbell Row
IMF-160.desc: Lie chest down on an incline bench, row dumbbells up.

IMF-161.name: Single-Arm Dumbbell Row, Hand on Bench
IMF-161.desc: One hand on a bench, row a dumbbell up to your hip.

IMF-162.name: Single-Arm Cable Row
IMF-162.desc: Pull one cable handle toward your ribs.

IMF-163.name: T-Bar Row, Chest Supported
IMF-163.desc: Chest on a pad, row a weighted bar toward you.

IMF-165.name: Machine Row, Neutral Grip
IMF-165.desc: Pull the handles back with elbows close to your sides.

IMF-166.name: Inverted Row
IMF-166.desc: Hang under a low bar, body straight, pull your chest to the bar.

IMF-168.name: Bent-Over Barbell Row
IMF-168.desc: Hinge forward and row a bar to your stomach.

IMF-169.name: Bent-Over Dumbbell Row
IMF-169.desc: Hinge forward and row dumbbells up.

IMF-171.name: Meadows Row

IMF-172.name: Face Pull

IMF-173.name: Reverse Pec Deck
IMF-173.desc: Sit facing the pad and swing your arms back and apart.

IMF-174.name: Rear Delt Cable Fly
IMF-174.desc: Cross cables and pull them apart to work the back of your shoulders.

IMF-175.name: Dumbbell Reverse Fly, Chest Supported
IMF-175.desc: Lie chest down on an incline bench, raise dumbbells out to the sides.

IMF-176.name: Shrug, Dumbbell
IMF-176.desc: Hold dumbbells at your sides and lift your shoulders toward your ears.

IMF-177.name: Shrug, Machine
IMF-177.desc: Lift your shoulders up against the machine's weight.

IMF-181.name: Dumbbell Shoulder Press, Seated
IMF-181.desc: Sit with back support, press dumbbells overhead.

IMF-183.name: Machine Shoulder Press
IMF-183.desc: Sit and push the handles overhead.

IMF-184.name: Barbell Overhead Press
IMF-184.desc: Press a bar from your shoulders to overhead.

IMF-185.name: Smith Machine Shoulder Press
IMF-185.desc: Press a bar overhead on fixed rails.

IMF-186.name: Arnold Press
IMF-186.desc: Start with palms facing you, rotate them forward as you press overhead.

IMF-188.name: Dumbbell Lateral Raise
IMF-188.desc: Lift dumbbells out to your sides to shoulder height.

IMF-189.name: Cable Lateral Raise
IMF-189.desc: Lift a cable handle out to your side to shoulder height.

IMF-190.name: Machine Lateral Raise
IMF-190.desc: Push your arms out to the sides against pads.

IMF-192.name: Dumbbell Front Raise

IMF-193.name: Cable Front Raise

IMF-194.name: Plate Front Raise
IMF-194.desc: Hold a weight plate and lift it in front to shoulder height.

IMF-195.name: Upright Row, Wide Grip

IMF-197.name: Band Pull-Apart
IMF-197.desc: Hold a band in front and pull it apart.

IMF-198.name: Cuban Press

IMF-199.name: External Rotation, Cable
IMF-199.desc: Elbow at your side, rotate your forearm outward against a cable.

IMF-200.name: External Rotation, Dumbbell Side-Lying
IMF-200.desc: Lie on your side, rotate a light dumbbell upward from your belly.

IMF-203.name: Dumbbell Curl, Standing
IMF-203.desc: Stand, bend your elbows to lift dumbbells toward your shoulders.

IMF-204.name: Dumbbell Curl, Seated
IMF-204.desc: Same curl while sitting on a bench.

IMF-205.name: Alternating Dumbbell Curl
IMF-205.desc: Curl one arm at a time.

IMF-206.name: Hammer Curl
IMF-206.desc: Curl with palms facing each other, like holding a hammer.

IMF-207.name: Cross-Body Hammer Curl
IMF-207.desc: Curl the dumbbell across your chest toward the opposite shoulder.

IMF-208.name: Incline Dumbbell Curl
IMF-208.desc: Sit on a tilted bench with arms hanging behind you, curl up.

IMF-209.name: Concentration Curl
IMF-209.desc: Sit, elbow braced on your inner thigh, curl one dumbbell.

IMF-210.name: Preacher Curl, Machine
IMF-210.desc: Arms on a sloped pad, curl the handles up.

IMF-211.name: Preacher Curl, Dumbbell
IMF-211.desc: Arm on a sloped pad, curl a dumbbell up.

IMF-212.name: Barbell Curl
IMF-212.desc: Curl a straight bar up toward your chest.

IMF-213.name: EZ-Bar Curl
IMF-213.desc: Curl a wavy bar that is easier on the wrists.

IMF-214.name: Cable Curl, Straight Bar
IMF-214.desc: Curl a bar attached to a low cable.

IMF-215.name: Cable Curl, Rope
IMF-215.desc: Curl a rope attached to a low cable.

IMF-216.name: Single-Arm Cable Curl
IMF-216.desc: Curl one cable handle at a time.

IMF-217.name: Spider Curl
IMF-217.desc: Lie chest down on an incline bench, arms hanging, curl up.

IMF-220.name: Zottman Curl

IMF-221.name: Resistance Band Curl
IMF-221.desc: Stand on a band and curl the handles up.

IMF-222.name: Cable Pushdown, Straight Bar
IMF-222.desc: Push a bar down from chest height until your arms are straight.

IMF-223.name: Cable Pushdown, Rope

IMF-224.name: Cable Pushdown, V-Bar

IMF-225.name: Single-Arm Cable Pushdown

IMF-230.name: Dumbbell Kickback
IMF-230.desc: Hinge forward, elbow at your side, straighten your arm behind you.

IMF-232.name: Close-Grip Push-Up
IMF-232.desc: Push-up with hands close together under your chest.

IMF-233.name: Close-Grip Bench Press
IMF-233.desc: Bench press with hands closer than shoulder width.

IMF-234.name: Bench Dip
IMF-234.desc: Hands on a bench behind you, lower your body down and press up.

IMF-235.name: Parallel Bar Dip, Upright Torso

IMF-236.name: Triceps Dip Machine

IMF-237.name: Diamond Push-Up
IMF-237.desc: Push-up with thumbs and fingers forming a diamond under your chest.

IMF-238.name: JM Press
IMF-238.desc: Hybrid of a skull crusher and a close-grip press, lower a bar toward your chin and press up.

IMF-239.name: Wrist Curl
IMF-239.desc: Forearms on your thighs, palms up, curl the weight up using only your wrists.

IMF-241.name: Dead Hang
IMF-241.desc: Hang from a bar for time.

IMF-242.name: Plate Pinch Hold

IMF-256.name: Jump Rope

IMF-260.note: Image shows a flat treadmill. Raise the incline so you are walking uphill.

IMF-262.name: Child's Pose
IMF-262.desc: Kneel, sit back on your heels, reach your arms forward on the floor.

IMF-263.name: Child's Pose with Side Reach
IMF-263.desc: From child's pose, walk both hands to one side to stretch your side body.
IMF-263.note: Image shows the basic pose. Walk both hands to one side to stretch your side.

IMF-264.name: Figure-Four Stretch
IMF-264.desc: Lie on your back, ankle on opposite knee, pull the legs toward you to stretch your glute.

IMF-265.name: Supine Hamstring Stretch with Strap
IMF-265.desc: Lie on your back, loop a strap around one foot, raise the straight leg.

IMF-268.name: Lying Knee-to-Chest Stretch
IMF-268.desc: On your back, hug one knee toward your chest.

IMF-269.name: Lying Spinal Twist, Gentle
IMF-269.desc: On your back, drop both knees to one side, shoulders stay down.

IMF-271.name: Standing Quad Stretch
IMF-271.desc: Stand and pull one heel toward your glute.

IMF-272.name: Standing Calf Stretch
IMF-272.desc: Hands on a wall, one leg back with heel down, lean forward.

IMF-273.name: Doorway Chest Stretch
IMF-273.desc: Forearm on a door frame, step through to stretch your chest.

IMF-274.name: Cross-Body Shoulder Stretch
IMF-274.desc: Pull one arm across your chest with the other arm.

IMF-275.name: Overhead Triceps Stretch
IMF-275.desc: Bend one arm behind your head and gently press the elbow with the other hand.

IMF-277.name: Upper Trap Stretch
IMF-277.desc: Tilt your ear toward your shoulder and gently add pressure with your hand.

IMF-279.name: Diaphragmatic Breathing, 90/90 Position
IMF-279.desc: On your back, calves on a bench, take slow deep belly breaths.

IMF-282.name: Foam Roll, Quads
IMF-282.desc: Lie face down with a roller under your thighs, slowly roll.

IMF-283.name: Foam Roll, Upper Back
IMF-283.desc: Roller under your upper back, arms crossed, slowly roll.

IMF-284.name: Foam Roll, Glutes
IMF-284.desc: Sit on a roller or ball, slowly roll over your glute muscles.

IMF-285.name: Foam Roll, Calves
IMF-285.desc: Sit with the roller under your calves, lift your hips and roll.

IMF-286.name: Foam Roll, Lats
IMF-286.desc: Lie on your side with the roller under your armpit area, slowly roll.

IMF-295.name: Ankle Mobility Rock
IMF-295.desc: Half kneeling, slide your knee forward over your toes with your heel down.

IMF-297.name: Breathing Drills, Box Breathing
IMF-297.desc: Breathe in for 4 seconds, hold 4, out 4, hold 4.
